ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity central region; continuous black low-intensity border along the leading and trailing edges; discrete black circular clusters at the far-left mid-lobe and scattered black points on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks on the outer third of the right trailing edge; lower-frequency, shallower waves on the left trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trajectory along the trailing edge leading to high-aspect-ratio distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white/grey textured clusters representing barnacle colonization concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity unaligned linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white field of both lobes, notably on the lower-left and central-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake-mark scarring across the ventral field and significant barnacle encrustation on the fluke margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread tan-yellow pixel staining (biostaining/diatom film) covering roughly 40% of the white high-intensity fluke area.
